elements_selected.content: Create tests/generate_fixtures.py script that builds the fixture database. Script must: 1) Read all files from tests/fixtures/corpus/ using Sense's own chunk_file() and classify_source_type(). 2) Embed all chunks via OpenAI API. 3) Write to tests/fixtures/sense_test.db with the same schema as the production DB. 4) Define gold-standard queries (minimum 8) covering 4+ source_types and 3+ projects. 5) Embed query texts and store in a query_fixtures table (id, query_text, embedding, expected_files JSON, expected_source_type, rationale). 6) Print summary of chunks indexed and queries stored. Script should use the test_config.toml for classification rules. Include a __main__ guard so it runs standalone.
